settings.heading: Answers, straight from the shop floor.
settings.lead: Everything people ask us about TOOSA tool storage: ordering, assembly, custom work, delivery and pickup, warranty and payment. Can't find it? Ask us directly.

settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.help_text: Call, email or send a message. A real person in Richmond, BC replies within one business day.

settings.question: What products does TOOSA offer?
settings.answer: TOOSA offers modular tool storage systems, rolling tool chests, workshop accessories, foam organization products, custom foam inserts and industrial air compressor solutions.

settings.question: Can I see TOOSA products before purchasing?
settings.answer: Yes. Selected products can be viewed at our Richmond, BC showroom. We recommend booking an appointment before visiting.

settings.question: Can you help me choose the right tool storage system?
settings.answer: Yes. Contact our team with information about your workspace, storage requirements and the tools you need to organize. We can help you compare available configurations.

settings.question: Do TOOSA tool chests require assembly?
settings.answer: Some TOOSA storage products require assembly. Instructions and the required hardware are provided where applicable.

settings.question: Can TOOSA assemble my product for me?
settings.answer: Professional assembly services are available on eligible products for an additional charge.

settings.question: Can I add my company logo to my tool box?
settings.answer: Laser engraving is available for eligible TOOSA products. Contact us or submit your design to discuss your requirements.

settings.question: Do you make custom foam tool inserts?
settings.answer: Yes. TOOSA can create precision-cut custom foam layouts based on your tools, dimensions or supplied design.

settings.question: Can I pick up my order?
settings.answer: Yes. Free local curbside pickup is available from our Richmond warehouse. Schedule your pickup after placing your order.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside the Lower Mainland?
settings.answer: Yes. Contact TOOSA for a delivery quote based on your destination and order requirements.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Local Lower Mainland delivery is currently listed at $100 CAD. Orders above $3,000 qualify for free shipping, while other locations may require a custom quote.

settings.question: Do TOOSA products include a warranty?
settings.answer: TOOSA currently provides a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects on its products. Product-specific warranties may vary, particularly for specialized equipment such as air compressors.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: TOOSA currently accepts major payment methods including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay.

settings.heading: See it before you decide.
settings.lead: Selected products are on the floor at our Richmond, BC showroom. Book a time and we'll walk you through the lineup.
